name: Harley-Davidson Dyna
engine: Twin Cam 96 or 103 V-twin, fuel injected (some 2006 carbureted), belt drive, six-speed
intro: The rubber-mount Twin Cam Dyna. Hydraulic cam tensioners, but the shoes still wear and should be checked.

add.title: Inspect the cam chain tensioner shoes
add.instructions: Take off the cam cover and look at the tensioner shoes for wear grooves and chunks missing. Replace them if they are worn.
add.reason: Worn shoes drop plastic into the oil and can let the cam chain slap.
add.src: Fix My Hog cam tensioner notes

G: Most 2006-2017 Dynas are fuel injected, but some 2006 bikes have a carb. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Cam tensioners
known.what: Harley moved Dynas to hydraulic tensioners in 2006, but the shoes still wear and are worth checking at higher miles.
